BETWEEN:-
 SMT. RAMPYARI BAI W/O SHRI AMAR CHAND, AGE 50  YE A R S , OCCUPATION: HOUSEWIFE, R/O VILLAGE  BHULAY, POLICE STATION DHARNAWADA, TEHSIL  RAGHOGARH, DISTRICT GUNA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RAJNISH SHARMA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION CANTT. DISTRICT GUNA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .
 (BY SHRI ROHIT MISHRA - ADDITIONAL ADVOCATE GENERAL)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER Case diary is available.

2. This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant as she has been arrested on 1.6.2023 in connection with Crime No.12/2023 registered at Police Station Cantt, District Guna for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

3. Prosecution story, in brief is that Rampyari Dhakad w/o Kamal Chandra Dhakad in connivance with other co-accused persons prepared a forged and fabricated document in the name of complainant's mother Rampyari Bheel w/o Chandan Singh Bheel and by impersonating herself as Rampyari Bheel w/o Chandan Singh Bheel, a member of Scheduled Tribe Community,
purchased/got executed a sale deed in favour of Rampyari Bheel with regard to agricultural land situated in village Vinayakkhedi.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that about 10 years prior to the incident applicant solemnized marriage with Chandan Singh Bheel and was living with him as wife.
She purchased the aforesaid land from Ramvilas Bheel.
She did not commit any crime.
Complainant has no locus to file complaint against the applicant.
Investigation has been completed and charge sheet has been filed.
The applicant has submitted copy of Aadhar Card and Rin Pustika in support of her submission.
The applicant is in custody since 1.6.2023.
Trial will take time to conclude and therefore, in the aforesaid circumstances, applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State has vehemently opposed the prayer and submits that admittedly the applicant has purchased a land from Ramvilas Bheel who is a member of Schedule Tribe Community and she was not entitled to purchase the aforesaid land from the member of Schedule Tribe community that is why she in connivance with other co-accused persons prepared forged and fabricated documents in the name of complainant's mother Rampyari Bheel and purchased the land by impersonating herself as Rampyari Bheel.
Allegations alleged against the applicant are of serious in nature.
6. Heard the learned counsel for both the parties.

7. Having considered the rival submission, material pointed out by the learned counsel for the applicant, documents produced on record so also the statement of the prosecution witnesses and the fact that the investigation has been completed and trial will take certainly long time, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, hence the application is allowed.

8. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for her appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr.P.C.
9.
This application is allowed and stands disposed of.
10. Certified copy, as per Rules.

(SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE (alok)
